description: Every file of the server that loads node:vm or calls eval( or new Function(, with the rules it may break and the reason. An entry with a removal issue goes with that issue; an entry without one (null) stays, and its reason says why it runs no input as code. server/tests/architecture/dynamicCode.test.js fails for a file that is not listed and for a listed rule the file no longer breaks. The vendored browser libraries of server/artifactLibraries/ are served to the browser and never run on the server; they are not scanned.

entries.reason: Frozen legacy workflow executor: a legacy loop node evaluates the condition the workflow author wrote in a fresh vm context with a time limit. The new workflow steps (#3774) evaluate no author code.
A pattern of an output schema is tested with a time limit: the vm context only runs re.test(text) on a compiled RegExp, so a catastrophic pattern cannot block the event loop. No input runs as code.
The script of a web artifact is compiled with vm.Script to report a syntax error to the model; it is parsed, never run.

A regular expression from configuration is run with a time limit: the vm context only runs re.test(text) on a compiled RegExp, so a catastrophic pattern cannot block the event loop. No input runs as code.
